Language Requirements

Aerospace Engineering (English track), Computer Science and Engineering (English track), Earth, Climate and Technology, Nanobiology.

  • TOEFL test reports obtained from January 21, 2026: A TOEFL iBT with an overall band score of 5.
    TOEFL test reports obtained before January 21, 2026: A TOEFL iBT with an overall band score of at least 90. TU Delft does not accept TOEFL MyBest scores; the required scores should be obtained in one single test.
  • IELTS (Academic version) with an overall band score of at least 6.5. Note: The IELTS Online (Academic) test and the IELTS Indicator test cannot be accepted.
  • Cambridge Assessment English: at least a C1 Advanced (Certificate of Advanced English; there are no requirements regarding the scores).

Certificates that are older than two years on the day you have uploaded the document and completed your application are not accepted.

Note: We advise you to register for the test of your choice well in advance. Depending on your location, registering for a test could take several months. If you are unable to obtain your English test results before the application deadline, your application cannot be considered. 

The following applicants are exempted from the English test requirement:

  • Nationals from the USA, U.K., Ireland, Australia, New Zealand and Canada.
  • Applicants who have obtained a secondary school diploma in one of the aforementioned countries.
  • Applicants with British A Levels or an International USA High School diploma.
  • Applicants with a European Baccalaureate if the language of instruction was English or if English 1 or English 2 was taken as a final examination subject.
  • Applicants with an International Baccalaureate (Diploma Programme) if the language of instruction was English or when English A Literature or English A Language and Literature (either HL or SL), is one of the IB exam subjects.
  • Applicants with a European secondary school diploma with a pass for English as a final examination subject.
  • Applicants with a Surinam VWO diploma with a pass for English as a final examination subject.

There are no Dutch language requirements for these programmes.

Aerospace Engineering (Bilingual, Dutch/English, track), Computer Science and Engineering (Bilingual, Dutch/English, track).

  • Nationals from the USA, U.K., Ireland, Australia, New Zealand and Canada.
  • Applicants who have obtained a secondary school diploma in one of the aforementioned countries.
  • Applicants with British A Levels or an International USA High School diploma.
  • Applicants with a European Baccalaureate if the language of instruction was English or if English 1 or English 2 was taken as a final examination subject.
  • Applicants with an International Baccalaureate (Diploma Programme) if the language of instruction was English or when English A Literature or English A Language and Literature (either HL or SL), is one of the IB exam subjects.
  • Applicants with a European secondary school diploma with a pass for English as a final examination subject.
  • Applicants with a Surinam VWO diploma with a pass for English as a final examination subject.
     

As the selection procedure is conducted in Dutch, a sufficient command of the Dutch language is required. The required proficiency level corresponds to Dutch at B2 level.
If you hold one of the secondary school diplomas / certificates listed below, you meet TU Delft's Dutch language requirement:  

  • Algemeen Secundair Onderwijs (ASO).
  • European Baccalaureate with Dutch as Language 1.
  • International Baccalaureate (Diploma Programme) with Dutch A (Language and Literature, or Literature) at HL or SL.
  • VWO Suriname (if the language of instruction was Dutch).
  • VWO The Netherlands Antilles (if the language of instruction was Dutch).
  • Staatsexamen Nederlands als Tweede Taal - Programma II (NT2-II) certificate.
  • CNaVT Educatief Startbekwaam (STRT) certificate.

If you do not possess one of these secondary school diplomas or certificates, we advise you to cancel your application and apply for the English taught programme before the application deadline (15 January).
 

A)    Dutch taught Numerus clausus BSc programmes:

Architecture Urbanism and Building Sciences, Clinical Technology.

  • TOEFL test reports obtained from January 21, 2026: A TOEFL iBT with an overall band score of 4.5.
    TOEFL test reports obtained before January 21, 2026: A TOEFL iBT with an overall band score of at least 70. TU Delft does not accept TOEFL MyBest scores; the required scores should be obtained in one single test.
  • IELTS (academic version) with an overall band score of at least 5.5. Note: The IELTS Indicator test is not accepted as it does not compare to the IELTS Academic test.

Certificates that are older than two years on the day you have uploaded the document and completed your application are not accepted.

As the selection procedure is conducted in Dutch and the programme is taught entirely in Dutch, a good command of the Dutch language is required. The required proficiency level corresponds to Dutch VWO level.

If you hold one of the secondary school diplomas / certificate listed below, you meet TU Delft's Dutch language requirement and can participate in the selection procedure:

  • Algemeen Secundair Onderwijs (ASO).
  • European Baccalaureate with Dutch as Language 1.
  • International Baccalaureate (Diploma Programme) with Dutch A (Language and Literature, or Literature) at HL or SL.
  • VWO Suriname (if the language of instruction was Dutch).
  • VWO The Netherlands Antilles (if the language of instruction was Dutch).
  • CNaVT Educatief Professioneel (EDUP) certificate.

Applicants who do not possess one of the secondary school diplomas / certificate listed above must take an assessment at TU Delft's Language Centre. Based on the results, additional Dutch language courses may be required. The assessment is available only to applicants who have received a conditional admission letter from TU Delft.
